17use crate::{
18    common::{DecoderRXingResult, DetectorRXingResult, Result},
19    exceptions::Exceptions,
20    BarcodeFormat, Binarizer, BinaryBitmap, DecodeHints, ImmutableReader, RXingResult,
21    RXingResultMetadataType, RXingResultMetadataValue, Reader,
22};
23
24use super::{decoder, detector::Detector};
25
26/**
27 * This implementation can detect and decode Aztec codes in an image.
28 *
29 * @author David Olivier
30 */
31#[derive(Default)]
32pub struct AztecReader;
33
34impl Reader for AztecReader {
35    /**
36     * Locates and decodes a Data Matrix code in an image.
37     *
38     * @return a String representing the content encoded by the Data Matrix code
39     * @throws NotFoundException if a Data Matrix code cannot be found
40     * @throws FormatException if a Data Matrix code cannot be decoded
41     */
42    fn decode<B: Binarizer>(&mut self, image: &mut BinaryBitmap<B>) -> Result<RXingResult> {
43        self.decode_with_hints(image, &DecodeHints::default())
44    }
45
46    fn decode_with_hints<B: Binarizer>(
47        &mut self,
48        image: &mut BinaryBitmap<B>,
49        hints: &DecodeHints,
50    ) -> Result<RXingResult> {
51        self.internal_decode_with_hints(image, hints)
52    }
53}
54
55impl ImmutableReader for AztecReader {
56    fn immutable_decode_with_hints<B: Binarizer>(
57        &self,
58        image: &mut BinaryBitmap<B>,
59        hints: &DecodeHints,
60    ) -> Result<RXingResult> {
61        self.internal_decode_with_hints(image, hints)
62    }
63}
64
65impl AztecReader {
66    fn internal_decode_with_hints<B: Binarizer>(
67        &self,
68        image: &mut BinaryBitmap<B>,
69        hints: &DecodeHints,
70    ) -> Result<RXingResult> {
71        // let notFoundException = None;
72        // let formatException = None;
73        let mut detector = Detector::new(image.get_black_matrix());
74
75        //  try {
76
77        let detectorRXingResult = if let Ok(det) = detector.detect(false) {
78            det
79        } else if let Ok(det) = detector.detect(true) {
80            det
81        } else {
82            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
83        };
84
85        let points = detectorRXingResult.getPoints();
86        let decoderRXingResult: DecoderRXingResult = decoder::decode(&detectorRXingResult)?;
87        // } catch (NotFoundException e) {
88        //   notFoundException = e;
89        // } catch (FormatException e) {
90        //   formatException = e;
91        // }
92        // if (decoderRXingResult == null) {
93        // try {
94        // let detectorRXingResult = detector.detect(true)?;
95        // points = detectorRXingResult.getPoints();
96        // decoderRXingResult = decoder::decode(&detectorRXingResult)?;
97        // } catch (NotFoundException | FormatException e) {
98        //   if (notFoundException != null) {
99        //     throw notFoundException;
100        //   }
101        //   if (formatException != null) {
102        //     throw formatException;
103        //   }
104        //   throw e;
105        // }
106        // }
107
108        if let Some(cb) = &hints.NeedResultPointCallback {
109            // if let DecodeHintValue::NeedResultPointCallback(cb) = rpcb {
110            for point in points {
111                cb(*point);
112            }
113            // }
114        }
115
116        let mut result = RXingResult::new_complex(
117            decoderRXingResult.getText(),
118            decoderRXingResult.getRawBytes().clone(),
119            decoderRXingResult.getNumBits(),
120            points.to_vec(),
121            BarcodeFormat::AZTEC,
122            chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis() as u128,
123        );
124
125        let byteSegments = decoderRXingResult.getByteSegments();
126        if !byteSegments.is_empty() {
127            result.putMetadata(
128                RXingResultMetadataType::BYTE_SEGMENTS,
129                RXingResultMetadataValue::ByteSegments(byteSegments.clone()),
130            );
131        }
132        let ecLevel = decoderRXingResult.getECLevel();
133        if !ecLevel.is_empty() {
134            result.putMetadata(
135                RXingResultMetadataType::ERROR_CORRECTION_LEVEL,
136                RXingResultMetadataValue::ErrorCorrectionLevel(ecLevel.to_owned()),
137            );
138        }
139        result.putMetadata(
140            RXingResultMetadataType::SYMBOLOGY_IDENTIFIER,
141            RXingResultMetadataValue::SymbologyIdentifier(format!(
142                "]z{}",
143                decoderRXingResult.getSymbologyModifier()
144            )),
145        );
146
147        Ok(result)
148    }
149}
